title: Clawd X Digest
summary: SpaceX's Historic Trillion-Dollar IPO: The SpaceX IPO has dominated market conversations, pushing the company to a staggering $1.75T valuation and officially making Elon Musk a trillionaire. The listing involved complex financial engineering and created significant fallout in the crypto space due to failed retail allocations.

AI Milestone in Physical Sports: In a major breakthrough for applied robotics, Sony's AI table tennis robot, Ace, successfully defeated world #26 Miyuu Kihara under official tournament rules, demonstrating unprecedented real-time athletic adaptation.

Developer Tooling Advancements: AI coding assistants are seeing rapid workflow improvements, highlighted by OpenAI granting users more control over Codex rate limit resets and the Gemini macOS app introducing seamless double-Command keystroke window attachments.

World Cup 2026 Kickoff Controversies: As the 2026 World Cup begins, off-field drama is taking center stage, notably with Canada denying entry to Ghana's Thomas Partey over legal charges, forcing him to miss the team's opening match.

Apple's 50th Anniversary Archival Reveal: Commemorating five decades of innovation, Apple granted rare access to a highly secretive room containing its hardware prototypes and history, unearthing early tech previously unseen even by CEO Tim Cook.

items.title: @elonmusk: Nvidia and SpaceX Deepen Partnership
items.body: Elon Musk highlighted Nvidia's ongoing collaboration with SpaceX following its historic IPO. The partnership continues to push accelerated computing boundaries to fuel AI and space exploration.

items.title: @WSJ: Apple Opens Secret Archive for 50th Anniversary
items.body: To commemorate its 50th year, Apple allowed Tim Cook and the WSJ inside a highly secretive room containing five decades of hardware prototypes. The archive holds early tech that even Cook had never seen.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Enhances Codex Rate Limit Resets
items.body: OpenAI is giving users more control over their API usage by allowing them to bank and choose when to apply their Codex rate limit resets. This flexibility aims to alleviate frustrations around unexpected limit resets during intense coding sessions.

items.title: @cjzafir: Optimizing Claude Code Token Limits
items.body: A developer shared a prompt engineering strategy to reduce Claude Code token burn by 50%. The method involves using Claude Fable 5 for planning, Codex 5.5 for execution, and Fable 5 Max for review.

items.title: @mranti: Sony AI Robot Defeats Table Tennis Pro
items.body: Sony's AI table tennis robot, Ace, achieved a major milestone by defeating Miyuu Kihara, the world's 26th-ranked player, under official ITTF rules. This marks a significant leap in robotics and real-time athletic AI.

items.title: @GeminiApp: Seamless Screen Context for Gemini macOS
items.body: The Gemini macOS app introduced a new feature allowing users to attach their active window to the chat instantly using a double Command (⌘) keystroke. This eliminates the need for manual screenshots or tab switching.

items.title: @behrin: The Financial Engineering Behind SpaceX's IPO
items.body: An analysis breaks down the complex financial maneuvers leading to SpaceX's $1.75T valuation, including xAI acquiring X and SpaceX subsequently acquiring xAI. The strategy leveraged a low float and index inclusion rules to drive a massive valuation increase.

items.title: @unusual_whales: The Scale of a Trillionaire's Wealth
items.body: With Elon Musk crossing the trillion-dollar mark, the average American's net worth is now mathematically closer to Jeff Bezos than Bezos is to Musk. This stark comparison highlights the unprecedented scale of a $1.2 trillion fortune.

items.title: @wolfyxbt: Crypto Exchanges Fumble SpaceX IPO Allocations
items.body: The crypto market faced a shock as exchanges that promised SpaceX IPO allocations to retail traders failed to deliver, offering refunds minus hefty fees. The fiasco heavily impacted traders who had attempted to delta-hedge their anticipated positions.

items.title: @PolymarketSport: $700k Polymarket Cashout on World Cup Match
items.body: A Polymarket bettor cashed out a nearly $700,000 position on South Korea to beat Czechia with only seconds remaining in the match. The perfectly timed exit secured massive profits as South Korea held onto a 2-1 lead with a 99% win probability.

items.title: @World_Insights1: Tracking Musk's Journey to $1.1T
items.body: A historical breakdown of Elon Musk's net worth reveals his trajectory from $28 million in 2000 to over $1.1 trillion in 2026. The timeline underscores the explosive wealth generation of the last few years, largely driven by his network of companies.

items.title: @ActuFoot_: Thomas Partey Denied Canada Visa for World Cup
items.body: Canada has refused entry to Ghanaian midfielder Thomas Partey due to his outstanding rape charges in London. As a result, he will miss Ghana's World Cup opening match against Panama in Toronto.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich to Extend Michael Olise
items.body: Following a stellar season that saw Michael Olise win Player of the Season and the double, Bayern Munich is moving to extend his contract until 2031. The club is reportedly prepared to nearly double his salary to ward off outside interest.

items.title: @DanHollick: 'Making Software' Book Enters Early Access
items.body: After thousands of hours of work, 70,000 words, and over 600 illustrations, 'Making Software' has been released in early access. The highly anticipated resource aims to provide deep visual and technical insights into software engineering.

items.title: @kiteandkeymedia: The Flaws in Natural Gas Forecasting
items.body: A new retrospective video highlights how historically inaccurate energy predictions have been, such as the White House's 1977 claim that the US would run out of natural gas by the early 21st century. The reality saw a massive surge in production instead.

items.title: @DaveBondyTV: Homeowner Hospitalized in Squatter Incident
items.body: A Flint, Michigan homeowner was hospitalized while squatters ransacked her property, prompting outrage. Neighbors report that local authorities have been unable or unwilling to intervene, shedding light on growing property rights issues.
